scherm-vervangen.name: Screen replacement
scherm-vervangen.summary: Cracks, lines, black spots or a touchscreen that no longer responds.
description: A cracked or unresponsive screen is the most common repair. The complete display assembly is replaced, so the picture, brightness and touch response work the way you are used to again.
Phone Repairs carries out the repair by appointment. Many screen repairs are done in about 30 minutes while you watch.

batterij-vervangen.name: Battery replacement
batterij-vervangen.summary: Your device drains quickly, shuts down unexpectedly or the battery has swollen.
description: A battery wears with every charge cycle. If your device no longer lasts the day or suddenly switches off, a new battery is often the solution.
Has the battery swollen? Stop charging the device and get in touch straight away.
advice: With a swollen battery: do not charge it and stop using the device. Get in touch straight away.

oplaadpoort-repareren.name: Charging port repair
oplaadpoort-repareren.summary: The cable is loose, charging only works at a certain angle or not at all.
description: Charging problems are often caused by dirt in the port or a damaged connector. After a check you will know whether cleaning is enough or the charging connector needs replacing.

camera-repareren.name: Camera repair
camera-repareren.summary: Blurry photos, a cracked camera lens or a camera that won't start.
description: Cracked camera glass or a faulty camera module makes sharp photos impossible. Depending on the cause, the lens glass or the complete module is replaced.

waterschade.name: Water damage
waterschade.summary: Your device got wet. Acting fast improves the chance of recovery.
description: Moisture can cause corrosion on the logic board. The sooner the device is examined, the better the chance it can be saved.
After the examination you will hear what is damaged and which repair is possible.
advice: Do not switch your device on and do not charge it.
Get in touch straight away so the device can be examined as soon as possible.

achterkant-vervangen.name: Back glass replacement
achterkant-vervangen.summary: Cracked back glass or a damaged housing.
description: A cracked back is more than a cosmetic problem: sharp edges and moisture getting in can cause further damage.

toetsenbord-vervangen.name: Keyboard replacement
toetsenbord-vervangen.summary: Keys that stick, type twice or no longer respond.
description: Sticking or dead keys can be caused by dirt, moisture or wear. After an examination you will hear which solution is possible.

overige-reparaties.name: Other repairs
overige-reparaties.summary: Buttons, speaker, microphone, vibration motor or a problem you can't pin down.
description: Not every fault fits in a box. Is a button not working, can you barely hear the other person, or are you not sure what is wrong? Get in touch and describe the problem.
Your data stays on your device during a repair.

afspraak-nodig.question: Do I need an appointment?
answer: Yes. Phone Repairs works by appointment only, so there is enough time and attention for your repair. You make an appointment via WhatsApp, by phone or by e-mail.

prijzen-inclusief.question: Do prices include VAT and fitting?
answer: Yes. Prices include fitting and 21% VAT.

parkeren.question: Can I park at the shop?
answer: Yes, there is free parking right outside.

openingstijden.question: When are you open?
answer: Phone Repairs is open seven days a week, including evenings. Because we work by appointment, you agree on a time that suits you.

eigen-onderdelen.question: Can I have parts fitted that I bought myself?
answer: No. Repairs are not carried out with parts you bought yourself. Phone Repairs works with its own original parts.

opsturen.question: Can I send my device in?
answer: Yes. Get in touch first, so we can check that the part is in stock and you know what the repair costs. Then send your device well packed and by registered mail.

faq-water-koffie-over-mijn-iphone-gegooi.question: My phone has water damage. Can it still be repaired?
answer: Often it can. If your smartphone got wet or damp and has water damage, switch it off right away (if it has not switched itself off already). This prevents further damage. Do not switch it on again and certainly do not charge it. Then call us straight away: 073 822 0013

faq-wat-kost-een-iphone-reparatie.question: What does an iPhone repair cost?
answer: The cost of an iPhone repair depends on the type of iPhone and the fault. iPhone repairs start from €60 including fitting and VAT. Repairs are done in 30 minutes while you watch!

faq-hoe-lang-duurt-een-iphone-reparatie.question: How long does an iPhone repair take?
answer: You can simply watch while your device is repaired, so you see what we do with your phone and your privacy stays protected. Most repairs take no longer than 30 minutes.

faq-mijn-batterij-is-slecht-kan-ik-dat-l.question: My battery is worn. Can I have it replaced?
answer: Yes, we can replace the worn battery within 30 minutes, so your device lasts longer again and you get through the day with your phone.

faq-mijn-toestel-laadt-niet-meer-op-kan-.question: My device no longer charges. Can it be repaired?
answer: You can often solve this yourself quite easily. Take a wooden toothpick and carefully clean the dirt out of the charging port. You will see a lot of dirt and dust come out. Usually your device will then charge properly again. Didn't that help? Get in touch to make an appointment and we will fix it for you.

faq-gebruiken-jullie-originele-onderdele.question: Do you use original parts?
answer: Yes. Wherever possible we repair with original parts. Depending on the brand, model and availability, we offer several high-quality options for screen repairs:
– Original Service Pack – a new original part, supplied by the manufacturer or an authorised supplier.
– Original pulled – an original part taken from another device and carefully checked for quality and function.
– Premium OLED – a high-quality alternative to the original screen. Premium OLED is not an original manufacturer part, but offers excellent image quality and performance at a more attractive price.
Which option is available differs per device. We discuss beforehand which part is used and what it costs, so you know exactly what you are choosing.

faq-krijg-ik-garantie-op-de-reparatie.question: Do I get a warranty on the repair?
answer: The warranty period differs per repair. Most repairs and all screen repairs come with a 12-month warranty. Batteries have 12 months and motherboard repairs 60 days. Water damage never comes with a warranty.

faq-mijn-scherm-is-beschadigd-kan-ik-dat.question: My screen is damaged. Can it be repaired?
answer: We can replace your phone's screen within 30 minutes while you watch, so you don't have to be without your device for long. And you can soon enjoy your phone again, without those annoying cracks in the screen.

faq-verlies-ik-mijn-data-bij-een-reparat.question: Will I lose my data during a repair?
answer: No, the data on your device is kept during a repair at Phone Repairs, so you don't need to worry. Your messages, WhatsApp, photos, games and so on simply stay on your device and you can use it again straight away.

faq-mijn-iphone-doet-ineens-niks-meer-wa.question: My iPhone suddenly does nothing. What can I do?
answer: Do a forced restart (hard reset). Sometimes a software error makes an iPhone seem completely unresponsive. A hard reset forces the logic board to restart without data loss:
– iPhone 8 and newer (including iPhones with Face ID): briefly press Volume Up, briefly press Volume Down, then hold the side button until the Apple logo appears.
– iPhone 7 (Plus) and older: hold the Volume Down button and the power button at the same time until the Apple logo appears.

faq-mijn-scherm-komt-omhoog-wat-is-er-aa.question: My screen is lifting. What is going on?
answer: This is often caused by a swollen battery, which is not harmless. Stop charging and using the device as soon as you notice it. Don't wait, because it is a fire and explosion risk. Make an appointment with us as soon as possible to have the battery replaced professionally, without risks such as fire, explosion or the release of toxic gases.

faq-mijn-achterkant-komt-omhoog-wat-is-e.question: My back cover is lifting. What is going on?
answer: This is often caused by a swollen battery, which is not harmless. Stop charging and using the device as soon as you notice it. Don't wait, because it is a fire and explosion risk. Make an appointment with us as soon as possible to have the battery replaced professionally, without risks such as fire, explosion or the release of toxic gases.

faq-de-achterkant-van-mijn-iphone-is-kan.question: The back of my iPhone is cracked. Is that a problem?
answer: Yes. The back, also called the back cover, holds important sensors that the iPhone needs to work properly. Damage to the back can damage these sensors and cause your iPhone to overheat. The battery can also be damaged, which can cause serious problems and even fire. Stop using the device and make an appointment with us soon to have the back replaced.

waterbestendig-na-schermvervanging.question: Is my phone still water-resistant after a screen replacement?
answer: After a screen replacement we cannot guarantee that your phone is water-resistant. An iPhone is water-resistant, but not completely waterproof. Cracks in the screen, dents in the frame and worn seals can reduce this protection.

When replacing the screen we also renew the screen adhesive and seal where needed. This lets us fit the screen carefully to the housing. However, it does not guarantee that the original water resistance is restored.
That is why we give no warranty on water resistance after a repair. Our advice: keep your phone away from water and don't submerge it, especially after it has been damaged or opened.
The above also applies to back glass replacement, battery replacement and all other repairs in which the device is opened.

garantie-schermreparatie.question: What does the screen repair warranty cover?
answer: If your screen stops working, we replace it free of charge. If your screen has drop, impact, water or visible user damage, it is no longer covered by our warranty. Your screen may also show black spots or lines while the glass is not broken. This too is caused by drop or impact damage and is unfortunately not covered by the warranty terms.

seo.title: Mail-in repair · Phone Repairs Den Bosch
seo.description: How to send your device to Phone Repairs for repair: get in touch first, fill in the send-in form, pack it well and send it by registered mail.

sections.heading: Important before you send your device
steps: Check stock and price beforehand: always get in touch with us first. That way we can check whether the parts you need are in stock and you know in advance what the repair costs.
Fill in the send-in form: print the send-in form, fill it in completely and include it with your device.
Don't send accessories: remove cases, screen protectors and SIM cards, and don't send charging cables, chargers or other accessories unless we specifically ask for them.
Pack your device carefully: use a sturdy box and enough protective packaging so the device is well protected in transit.
Always send it by registered mail: that way the shipment can be tracked and you have proof of postage.
body: In short: even if you don't live nearby, you can use the Phone Repairs repair service. Get in touch with us first, send your device to us safely and we'll make sure it comes back to you neatly after the repair.

sections.heading: What are the shipping costs?
body: Phone Repairs charges €12 for returning your device within the Netherlands (registered and insured via PostNL). For rates and shipping methods outside the Netherlands or outside Europe, please get in touch with us.

sections.heading: What does repairing my device cost?
body: You can find the rates per brand and model on our website.

sections.heading: How should I send my device?
body: Make sure your device is packed safely and well protected, preferably in a sturdy box and wrapped in bubble wrap. Fill the whole box with packing material so the device cannot move in transit. Always send your device by registered mail, so you receive official confirmation from PostNL once we have received it. Please don't send accessories such as chargers, cables, cases and so on. Always include the completely filled-in form.

sections.heading: How long does the repair take?
body: Once Phone Repairs has received your device, we contact you within a few hours. By then we have already examined your device and can tell you what the repair costs. If you agree, we aim to have your device repaired within 1-2 working days after receipt and payment (provided the part is in stock). We then return it to you by registered mail via PostNL.

sections.heading: Do I get a warranty on the repair?
body: Yes, you get a standard 12-month warranty on the replaced parts.

sections.heading: How can I pay?
body: You can pay via the payment link we send you.

garantie.title: Warranty on repairs
garantie.intro: At Phone Repairs Den Bosch we stand behind the quality of our repairs. That is why almost every repair comes with a warranty. The warranty period depends on the type of repair and ranges from 60 days to 12 months, so you know where you stand beforehand.

seo.title: Warranty on repairs: what you need to know
seo.description: At Phone Repairs Den Bosch your repair comes with a warranty of up to 12 months. Read what is covered and for how long.

sections.heading: Warranty on repairs
body: At Phone Repairs Den Bosch you can watch most repairs and see how we repair your device with great expertise. We give every repair the time and attention it needs, which is why we work by appointment. To make an appointment, call us or send a WhatsApp message.

sections.heading: How much warranty do you get?
body: Most repairs come with a 12-month warranty. Water damage and specialist motherboard repairs have other warranty terms.

sections.heading: Screen repairs – 12 months warranty
intro: All screen repairs come with a 12-month warranty on the working of the screen we fitted.
This applies to screen repairs with:
body: The warranty period starts when the repaired device is handed over or shipped to you.
bullets: Original Service Pack
Original pulled
Premium OLED

sections.heading: Other repairs – 12 months warranty
body: Other regular repairs come with a 12-month warranty on the working of the part we replaced, such as a charging port, camera, speaker, microphone or other part.

sections.heading: Motherboard repair and micro-soldering – 60 days warranty
body: A motherboard or micro-soldering repair comes with a 60-day warranty. This covers repairs to ICs, filters, FPC connectors and other components on the motherboard. The warranty only applies to the part or area of the motherboard that Phone Repairs repaired.

sections.heading: Pre-owned devices – 12 months warranty
body: Our pre-owned devices come with a 12-month warranty. They are fully tested and checked before they are sold.

sections.heading: Data recovery – no cure, no pay
body: Data recovery has no regular repair warranty. It is carried out on a no cure, no pay basis: if the data agreed beforehand cannot be recovered, you do not pay for the recovery.

sections.heading: Water damage – no warranty
body: We give no warranty on the examination, cleaning or repair of devices with moisture, water or other liquid damage. Moisture can cause corrosion and other damage in many places inside a device, so new faults can appear later, even after a successful cleaning or repair.

sections.heading: What does the warranty cover?
body: The warranty only covers the working of the part that Phone Repairs replaced or repaired during that repair. If we replaced a screen, for example, the warranty covers that screen. Other parts and functions of the device that were not replaced or repaired are not covered, including peripheral components: with a screen repair, the proximity sensor, Face ID, Touch ID, speakers and other parts that were not replaced fall outside the warranty on the new screen.

sections.heading: When does the warranty lapse?
intro: The warranty is meant for a defect in the part we replaced or repaired. It does not cover damage to the device or part that occurs after the repair.
Among other things, the warranty lapses with:
body: Such damage voids the warranty on the part concerned. Moisture, water, liquid or lightning damage also cannot be claimed under the repair warranty.
bullets: ✕ Drop, impact or pressure damage
✕ Cracks, breaks, tears and scratches
✕ Visible physical damage or damage caused by use
✕ Damage to LCD, OLED or AMOLED panels and digitizers
✕ Black spots, lines or other visible display damage caused by physical damage
✕ Moisture, water or liquid damage
✕ Heat damage, including adhesive layers coming loose due to external heat
✕ Hinges damaged or broken by physical strain
✕ Other visible damage that occurred after the repair

sections.heading: No warranty on parts that were not repaired
body: The warranty does not apply to parts that Phone Repairs did not repair or replace during the original repair. Say we only replaced the screen and a few months later a problem appears with Face ID, Touch ID, the proximity sensor, camera or speaker: that part is not covered by the warranty on the screen repair if we did not replace or repair it. This keeps it clear what the warranty covers: the part and the work you paid Phone Repairs for.

sections.heading: Cleaning and maintenance
body: Cleaning and maintenance work comes without a warranty, unless the repair invoice explicitly states otherwise.

sections.heading: When does the warranty start?
intro: The warranty period starts on the date the repaired product is:

waterschade-reparatie-phone-repairs.title: Water damage repair
waterschade-reparatie-phone-repairs.intro: Water damage calls for immediate action. The longer moisture stays in your device, the greater the risk of corrosion and further damage to the electronics.

seo.title: Water damage repair: what to do
seo.description: How water damage repair works and what to do right away to save your smartphone, tablet or MacBook.

sections.heading: Have your device checked as soon as possible
body: With moisture damage, time matters. Bring your phone, tablet or MacBook to us as soon as you can: the sooner we examine and treat it, the better the chance of limiting further damage. We can clean the device professionally and check it for moisture, corrosion and other damage to parts such as the motherboard (PCB). Call us straight away for an appointment on 073 822 0013.

The standard water damage treatment costs €60 including VAT and fitting. Some devices, such as MacBooks and foldables, have a different rate, so just ask us. This covers the specialist labour, chemicals and equipment, and applies whether or not the device can be restored. The turnaround is 3 to 4 working days on average (weekends excluded).

sections.heading: Good to know about water damage
body: No device is completely waterproof. Even an official IP rating does not mean a smartphone can withstand every kind of moisture or liquid. Moisture damage is also not covered by the manufacturer's warranty.
Water damage? Don't switch it on, don't charge it and have it checked as soon as possible. That way you avoid causing unnecessary extra damage.
Has your smartphone, tablet, MacBook or Nintendo Switch suffered moisture damage? Phone Repairs Den Bosch cleans your device thoroughly to stop corrosion and further damage and to save your data.

The main goal is always to get the device working so your important data can be secured. Keep in mind that a device with moisture damage may work only partly or temporarily; later faults can never be ruled out. That is why we give no warranty on water damage. So make a backup of your data as soon as you pick up your device!

sections.heading: But isn't my device waterproof?
intro: The term "waterproof" can be misleading for smartphones. Many modern smartphones are designed to withstand some exposure to water, but that does not make them fully waterproof. The short answer: no, phones are water-resistant, not waterproof, and that is no guarantee against damage.
A few points to keep in mind:
body: What to do with moisture damage? Prevention remains the best advice: keep your smartphone away from liquids and steam as much as possible. Did your device get wet anyway? Switch it off right away, dry the outside well, don't charge it and contact us immediately. The sooner the liquid is removed professionally, the better the chance of a full recovery.

Apple, for example, states that the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max are splash, water and dust resistant and rated IP68 under IEC standard 60529 (up to 30 minutes at a depth of 2 metres, tested under controlled conditions), that this resistance may decrease over time as a result of normal wear, that you should not try to charge a wet iPhone, and that liquid damage is not covered by the warranty.
Water damage can also cause motherboard faults; our motherboard repair rates then apply.
bullets: An IP rating is no free pass: a rating such as IP68 means a device was tested under ideal lab conditions (for example up to 1.5 metres deep for 30 minutes in still fresh water). Real life is very different.
Not resistant to every liquid: the protection only applies to cold fresh water. Salt water, chlorinated water, soapy water, hot steam (bathroom or sauna) and chemicals attack the seals straight away.
Only meant for accidents: the seal is an emergency measure for a drop in a puddle or a rain shower, not for taking photos under water or using the device in the shower.
Wear reduces protection: drops, knocks, normal ageing of the rubber seals or earlier repairs gradually reduce water resistance. A one-year-old device is far less protected than a new one.
No warranty on water damage: no manufacturer, and Phone Repairs neither, covers moisture damage under warranty, whatever the device's IP rating.
Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI): this indicator inside your device changes colour when it gets wet, after which the manufacturer's warranty no longer applies.

sections.heading: No warranty on water damage
body: Manufacturers, and we neither, never give a warranty on water or drop damage. A repairer can easily detect water damage, because all mobile devices contain indicators that change colour on contact with moisture.

moederbord-reparatie-den-bosch.intro: The latest SMD components are so small that they can no longer be fitted with a traditional soldering iron, but hot-air soldering makes it possible. A hot-air station with a powerful heating element lets us de-solder and solder the smallest components, QFPs and BGAs by hand on the motherboard (the printed circuit board). We use professional tools from brands including Amscope, Wiha, Hakko, Baku, Quick and Fluke.

sections.heading: Hot-air soldering
body: Repairs must be done properly and must last. That is why we only use original parts and give two months' warranty on motherboard repairs and the parts replaced.

sections.heading: Repair risks
body: Electronic repairs are unpredictable. Your device may turn out to be beyond repair or may be permanently damaged and become unusable during the repair. Circuit board components deteriorate over time and can fail without warning, especially in devices with liquid damage, where components can short-circuit, oxidise, corrode and rust over time.

For devices with glued screens, such as iPads, the screen has to be prised loose to reach the internal components. Screens are very fragile and can crack or break while being prised open. We have a lot of experience and the risk of breakage is minimal, but glass can break and there are risks. That is the honest story.

Touch ID / Face ID on Apple devices can fail and become unusable during motherboard repairs. Although this is uncommon, it can happen depending on the condition of the device, and it cannot be determined in advance.
The above is therefore never covered by a warranty, because these are the risks of the repair. This risk lies entirely with the customer.

sections.heading: Calibrating iPhone parts
body: From iOS 18 and on iPhone 12 and newer, a part can be calibrated (paired with your iPhone) after a screen, battery, camera or back cover repair. duurzaamheid-en-telefoonreparatie.title: Sustainability
duurzaamheid-en-telefoonreparatie.intro: Smartphones keep getting more advanced, yet they are often replaced while they are technically still fine. A cracked screen, a worn battery or a faulty part does not have to be the end of your phone: in many cases a targeted repair can extend its life considerably.

seo.title: Sustainability and phone repair
seo.description: Why repairing your phone is the sustainable choice: use it longer, cut electronic waste and hand in old devices responsibly.

sections.heading: Sustainability and phone repair: using it longer starts with repairing
body: Using a device longer also means you need a new one less quickly. That postpones the demand for new raw materials and production, and keeps a usable smartphone from ending up as electronic waste too soon.

Repairing can also make financial sense. A screen or battery replacement often costs considerably less than a comparable new device, so you get more out of the phone you already have and may postpone a new purchase for years.

In short: by first checking whether a repair is possible, you make a conscious choice for a longer life for your smartphone. Below we explain how repairing, maintaining and reusing can help reduce electronic waste and make our smartphone use more sustainable.

sections.heading: The environmental impact of electronics
body: Producing a new smartphone takes raw materials, energy and transport. Smartphones need lithium, cobalt, copper and various other metals, and mining, processing and transporting these materials has an environmental impact.

A large part of a smartphone's climate impact arises before you even use it: during the extraction of raw materials and the production of the parts and the device itself. According to Milieu Centraal, using electronic devices for longer therefore brings significant environmental gains.

That is exactly why repairing can make a difference. By replacing a worn battery or a cracked screen, an otherwise well-functioning smartphone can often last a long time. You postpone buying a new device, fewer new raw materials are needed and a usable device does not become electronic waste too soon.

sections.heading: Repairing fits a circular economy
body: In a circular economy, products and raw materials are used as long as possible and reused where possible. Instead of buying, using and throwing away, the focus is on maintaining, repairing, reusing and recycling.
Phone repair fits right in. By replacing only the faulty part, a whole device does not have to be written off because of a broken screen, a poor battery or a faulty charging connector.
The Dutch government is also working towards a circular economy, with the goal of being fully circular by 2050. You can read more about this on the Rijksoverheid website: Nederland circulair in 2050.

sections.heading: What can you do yourself?
intro: You can also use your own smartphone more consciously:
bullets: Use your device as long as possible. Is your smartphone still working well? Then replacing it is not automatically necessary.
Have faults assessed first. A broken screen, worn battery or other fault can often be repaired.
Choose quality parts. A good repair with reliable parts can help your device last longer.
Consider pre-owned. Do you need another phone after all? A technically checked pre-owned device can be an alternative to a new one.
Hand in old electronics responsibly. Is a device really no longer usable or repairable? Hand it in at a suitable collection point, so valuable materials can be recovered.

sections.heading: Repair before you replace
body: Using electronics more sustainably starts with using what you already have for longer. A cracked screen or worn battery does not always mean you need a new smartphone.

That is why Phone Repairs Den Bosch first looks at what can be repaired. By replacing a faulty part, your trusted device can often last a long time again. That saves buying a new phone and helps keep electronics in use for longer.
In short: repair first, replace later. You get more out of your smartphone and help reduce electronic waste.

sections.heading: Hand in your old devices responsibly at Phone Repairs
body: Do you have an old smartphone, tablet or other small electronic device that you no longer use? Don't just throw it away, but hand it in responsibly. You can leave discarded electronic devices with Phone Repairs Den Bosch so they can be processed properly.
Why does that matter? Electronic devices contain various valuable materials that can be recovered and reused, and proper processing keeps electronic waste out of the general waste.
That is why we first check whether a device can still be repaired or reused. If not, responsible recycling is the next step, so devices and raw materials stay in the loop as long as possible.
In short: is there an old phone or tablet in a drawer at home? Feel free to bring it to Phone Repairs, so together we make sure old electronics get a responsible new destination.

body: In short: you don't have to spend hours searching for the right settings or solutions yourself. With our personal phone help, we make sure your smartphone or tablet works the way you want it to again.

sections.heading: By appointment
body: We have very generous opening hours: we repair during the day but also in the evenings, at weekends and even on Sundays and public holidays. ios-27-batterijproblemen.title: iOS 27 battery problems
ios-27-batterijproblemen.excerpt: Is your battery draining faster after the update to iOS 27? That is usually temporary.
summary: After a major iOS update many people notice the battery draining faster and the device getting warmer. That is usually temporary.
Right after the update your iPhone runs heavy optimisation tasks in the background. After a few days they are done and battery use returns to normal.

waterdichtheid-smartphones.title: How water resistant are smartphones?
waterdichtheid-smartphones.excerpt: A smartphone is water resistant, not waterproof. What does that mean in practice?
summary: Smartphones are water resistant, not waterproof. The protection applies to cold, fresh water.
Salt water, chlorinated water and hot steam can damage the seals. Water damage is never covered by warranty, whatever your device's IP rating.

flexible-hydrogel-screen-protectors.title: Flexible hydrogel screen protector
flexible-hydrogel-screen-protectors.excerpt: According to Phone Repairs, a hydrogel screen protector is the best protection for your screen.
summary: A flexible hydrogel screen protector protects your screen against scratches and cracks.
Is the screen broken anyway? A screen replacement is usually done within 30 minutes while you watch.

iphone-duo-wat-biedt-apples-eerste-opvou.title: iPhone Duo: what does Apple's first foldable iPhone offer?
iphone-duo-wat-biedt-apples-eerste-opvou.excerpt: An iPhone you unfold for a bigger screen: with the iPhone Duo, Apple introduces a new way of using your phone.
summary: An iPhone you unfold for a bigger screen: with the iPhone Duo, Apple introduces a new way of using your phone. The device combines two screens with a design that opens like a book. What does that mean in practice, and what should you look out for if you want to switch? Phone Repairs Den Bosch lists the main points.

The device has a 5.4-inch outer screen and a foldable 7.6-inch inner screen. Folded, you can read messages and use your phone for everyday tasks; unfolded you get more room for documents, websites and videos. It remains a personal trade-off: a wider device feels different in your hand and pocket than a traditional iPhone.

batterij-van-je-telefoon-of-laptop-opgez.title: Swollen battery in your phone or laptop? Here is what to do
batterij-van-je-telefoon-of-laptop-opgez.excerpt: Is the back or screen of your phone lifting, or does your laptop no longer close properly? These can be signs of a swollen battery.
summary: Is the back of your phone lifting, or the screen? Does your laptop no longer close properly, or does your device suddenly wobble on a flat table? These can be signs of a swollen battery. Your device does not have to be written off, but it is important to act straight away.
Stop using your device and stop charging it! A swollen battery is damaged and can cause a fire. Have your device assessed by a specialist: make an appointment and get free advice from us.

wegwijs-in-apples-zelfontwikkelde-chips.title: A guide to Apple's own chips
wegwijs-in-apples-zelfontwikkelde-chips.excerpt: Apple chips explained: what does the processor mean for your device?
summary: Apple chips explained: what does the processor mean for your device?

Opening an app, taking a photo or making a video call all involve computing work, and Apple uses its own chips for it. Names like A19, M4 and H2 sound technical, but mainly tell you what task a chip was made for. What do you notice in daily use? And if your iPhone gets slower, is the processor to blame?

snapdragon-8-elite-gen-6-wat-betekenen-d.title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6: what do the new chips mean for your smartphone?
snapdragon-8-elite-gen-6-wat-betekenen-d.excerpt: New Snapdragon chips. But do you need a new phone?
summary: New Snapdragon chips. But do you need a new phone?
The Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 promises more speed and new possibilities. What do you notice in daily use, and when is it better to keep using your current device?

legendarische-apple-reclames.title: Legendary Apple commercials
legendarische-apple-reclames.excerpt: Over the years Apple has made many commercials that became beautiful, moving and iconic. Here are my (Martijn's) favourites.
summary: Over the years Apple has made many commercials that became beautiful, moving and iconic. Here are my (Martijn's) favourites.

1984 (Super Bowl, 1984): directed by Ridley Scott to introduce the Macintosh. It showed a dystopian world inspired by George Orwell, broken open by a woman throwing a hammer, and set the tone for Apple's rebellious image.

een-back-up-maken-van-je-iphone-of-andro.title: How to back up your iPhone or Android phone
een-back-up-maken-van-je-iphone-of-andro.excerpt: Your smartphone holds almost your whole life, and the data on it is priceless. A regular backup saves you a lot of stress.
summary: Our smartphones run almost our whole lives, and the data on them is priceless. Want to avoid losing precious photos or important files? Good preparation is half the work, and a regular backup saves you a lot of stress. This article shows how to back up your iPhone or Android device quickly and easily.

iCloud is a simple and easy way to back up your iOS device. Every registered iOS user gets 5 GB of free iCloud storage, and you can back up your iPhone with a few clicks whenever you like, or let it happen automatically so you don't forget.

klinken-nieuwe-smartphones-straks-minder.title: Will new smartphones sound worse because of the chip shortage?
klinken-nieuwe-smartphones-straks-minder.excerpt: Will new smartphones sound worse because of the chip shortage?
summary: Will new smartphones sound worse because of the chip shortage?

You buy a brand-new smartphone and expect improvements in almost every area: a faster processor, better cameras, a brighter screen and of course good sound. Yet that last point could come under pressure in some future smartphones. Strong global demand for memory chips, partly for AI data centres, is squeezing memory availability and prices, so manufacturers look critically at costs, including components that are less visible to consumers.

samsung-galaxy-z-fold-8-recordaantal-pre.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8: record pre-orders, but is a foldable phone right for you?
samsung-galaxy-z-fold-8-recordaantal-pre.excerpt: A phone that fits in your pocket and unfolds for extra screen space: the idea behind a foldable smartphone remains attractive.
summary: A phone that fits in your pocket and unfolds for extra screen space: the idea behind a foldable smartphone remains attractive, and interest in Samsung's latest Fold models is high. But what do sales records say about daily use? And what should you look out for when you buy or repair such a device?
You can come to Phone Repairs in Den Bosch with questions about your foldable Samsung. This article looks at the popularity of the Galaxy Z Fold 8, maintenance and the options when it gets damaged.

iphone-problemen-oplossen.title: Solving iPhone problems
iphone-problemen-oplossen.excerpt: Solving iPhone problems: from a battery that drains fast to a screen that doesn't respond.
summary: Solving iPhone problems: from a battery that drains fast to a screen that doesn't respond.

Your iPhone no longer charges, switches off unexpectedly or doesn't respond to touch. Maybe the camera isn't working properly or people can barely hear you on calls. Such problems are annoying, but they don't automatically mean you need a new phone.

originele-apple-opladers-en-kabels-waaro.title: Original Apple chargers and cables: why quality matters
originele-apple-opladers-en-kabels-waaro.excerpt: Charging seems simple, yet the adapter and cable help determine how safely and reliably it happens.
summary: You plug in your iPhone, the battery icon appears and you carry on with your day. Charging seems simple, yet the adapter and cable help determine how safely and reliably it happens. An accessory that looks fine and charges your phone is not necessarily well designed.

Original Apple chargers and cables are a reliable choice, provided you use the right type and buy them from a reliable seller. Suitable accessories from other manufacturers can also work safely; the big risk lies in counterfeits, substandard parts and products of unclear origin or specifications.

iphone-premium-oled-aftermarket-schermen.title: iPhone premium OLED (aftermarket) screens
iphone-premium-oled-aftermarket-schermen.excerpt: Give your iPhone a premium OLED (non-original) screen, without the Apple price tag.
summary: Give your iPhone a premium OLED (non-original) screen, without the Apple price tag.

Tired of a damaged or dull screen, but not willing to pay top price? Our premium OLED screens deliver almost exactly the deep colours and razor-sharp image you are used to, at a more affordable price.

waarom-repareren-van-telefoons-essentiee.title: Why repairing phones matters
waarom-repareren-van-telefoons-essentiee.excerpt: Sustainability and phone repair: using it longer starts with repairing.
summary: Sustainability and phone repair: using it longer starts with repairing.

Smartphones keep getting more advanced, yet they are often replaced while they are technically still fine. A cracked screen, a worn battery or a faulty part does not have to be the end of your phone: in many cases a targeted repair can extend its life considerably.
